method: One warm-up; rotated variants for each distribution. Inputs parsed and ASTs compiled before timers. Reference/control freeze deep comparison copies and full-size result reservation; full-current calls the actual evaluator. Components expose source materialization, validated comparison preparation and sorting. Reference reserves full output then deduplicates/fills; current compacts distinct rows, reserves distinct output and fills. Preparation includes validation and rows. Logical phase deltas count requests above the same temporary arena; backing peaks include earlier live phases. Region release frees backing capacity in bulk, not individual logical requests. Full-query intervals include map/keys plus unique and exclude encoding, parse, compilation and cleanup. Every result matches public execution bytes; backing cleanup must reach zero. Components are not summed as independent microbenchmarks or new observed workflows.
